summary: A volunteer calls the absent delegation one household at a time to find out who knew about the meeting.
realLife: Lynn Hamilton followed up with Washington County delegates and alternates and learned of a move, missing notice and an appointment made without the appointee’s knowledge.
gates: A precinct has gone unrepresented and a contact list survives.
inGame: needs: a dated roll call and a separate contact outcome for each absent person.

turns.what: The volunteer reaches the delegate the next day.
turns.pulledBy: A relative supplies a forwarding number.
turns.writesBack: The list gains a confirmed contact and date.

turns.what: The volunteer reports the vacancy to the precinct.
turns.pulledBy: A listed alternate declines the appointment.
turns.writesBack: The next notice goes to a replacement only after selection.
